relationships.subject: ambroxol
relationships.evidence_quote: Ambroxol-induced tonic inhibition was stronger on rNav1.8 (IC<sub>50</sub> 18 µM) than on hNav1.8 (IC<sub>50</sub> 279 µM)

relationships.subject: ambroxol
relationships.evidence_quote: Ambroxol also inhibited capsaicin-induced currents on hTRPV1 in a concentration-dependent and partly reversible manner.

relationships.subject: ambroxol
relationships.evidence_quote: Currents induced by mustard oil or carvacrol on hTRPA1 exhibited a concentration-dependent reduction by ambroxol that was stronger on outward as compared to inward currents.

relationships.subject: ambroxol
relationships.evidence_quote: A weak but concentration-dependent activation of hTRPV1 and hTRPA1 exceeded an unspecific increase in intracellular calcium by high concentrations of ambroxol.

key_findings: Ambroxol blocks rat Nav1.8 (IC50 18 µM) more potently than human Nav1.8 (279 µM).
High ambroxol concentrations weakly activate and inhibit capsaicin-/agonist-induced hTRPV1 and hTRPA1 currents.
